claims.claim: 5. Settings are included in export or backup. They are not. PortableArchive has no reference to KeyValueStore or SharedPreferences, only comments and strings mentioning the Settings screen. Android also excludes sharedpref from cloud backup and device transfer, and sets allowBackup=false. The desktop Settings screen says backups are Android-only.

6. A setting change is observed reactively (Flow). The interface has a Flow-returning observe(key), and MapKeyValueStore implements it with one MutableStateFlow per key that put() updates. UI code collects it with collectAsState. Some call sites read once with get(), for example Main.kt window frame, CalendarScreen default view, the ViewModel initial reads of calendar_layers and roadmap_filter, and PageDetailViewModel's ai_model.

missed.fact: The store is String-only. Booleans are encoded as "true"/"false" and ints as digits. A malformed value silently falls back to the caller's default because getBoolean uses toBooleanStrictOrNull and getInt uses toIntOrNull.

AndroidKeyValueStore.persist calls prefs.edit().clear() and then rewrites every key on each put. The Android constructor copies only String-typed values from tendril_kv, so non-String entries in that file are dropped on the next write.
Only observe() emits changes, and only for keys already observed. put() updates the flow of an existing key but creates none. put(key, null) removes the key and emits null.
Desktop has a second settings store outside the KeyValueStore: java.util.prefs.Preferences holds sync_folder_path, per-user registry-backed on Windows, separate from prefs.properties.

Android keeps several settings in separate SharedPreferences classes outside the KeyValueStore (AppLock, CalendarProvider, SystemCalendar, SyncStatus, SyncFolder). A merge of settings must handle these too.

The KeyValueStore is also used for non-preference UI state, not only user settings: window_frame, popout_pages and per-page popout frames, pane widths, pages_shelf and pages_tree_collapsed. These are per-device layout state, so they would not want to sync.
Legacy Android SharedPreferences values (theme, task prefs) are migrated into the KeyValueStore at startup by migrateLegacyThemePreferences and migrateLegacyTaskPreferences.
The desktop AI key file is DPAPI-wrapped, with a legacy bare-line format that is rewritten wrapped on first load. Clearing the key deletes the file.
